_comment: A dated snapshot of Tokenizario's statement vocabulary v3, the attestation catalogue that rwa/data/restatements/ uses to say every researched product as 'X says Y about Z'. The canonical catalogue lives in the Tokenizario repository (docs/vocabulary.md, frontend/src/lib/vocabulary.ts); refresh this snapshot when it changes, and rwa/restatement.test.js compares the two when TOKENIZARIO_REPO points at a checkout.
canonicalSource: emergent-rwa, branch solana-mobile-hackathon: docs/vocabulary.md and frontend/src/lib/vocabulary.ts
principles: A statement is a signed, typed claim. The app records, shows and counts it and never acts on it.
Chain facts are the only facts: the token holder, who signed what and when, what a token committed to at creation, identifier tags and burns.
Types define the system; free text exists only inside a type.
A lens is how a reader counts statements, and readers choose it.
Terms are the parties' own link or text, committed by hash. The law applies.

groups.name: About the token and the record

types.says: Asset: I have it for the token holder. Claim: I owe what it describes. Share: the token holder has a share in it; I keep the register. Memento: no rights against me.
types.signedBy: the wallet that creates the token, together with the token

types.says: I saw it.
I examined it.
It is worth X (basis appraisal, offer or paid).
It is stolen, or it is lost.
The token left my wallet without my consent.
types.signedBy: anyone but the current token holder

types.says: Anything else. No typed meaning.
I have it, for the token holder or for X.
I handed it to you.
Received.
Collect it by date.
I no longer have it (returned, donated, disposed, sold elsewhere).
A five-minute signed code that shows the asset holder the collector holds the token. Never registered.
Yours for this price until this date.
Yes, to a sale offer or a request addressed to me.
No, to a sale offer, a hand-over or a request.
I paid, or I received payment, for a sale or a notice to collect.
types.signedBy: the buyer or seller; the token holder or asset holder for a notice

types.says: Please add a statement of this kind.
Done, as asked.
That token replaces mine.
types.signedBy: the token holder of the earlier token

types.says: I withdraw this statement of mine.
types.signedBy: only the wallet that signed the original

types.says: This statement is wrong, not theirs, unpaid, a duplicate or compromised.
I attest the same. On a profile, a vouch; from the token holder on a security interest, an acknowledgement.
In my view: for the holder, for the flagger, or undetermined.
types.signedBy: anyone; ranked by the arbiters a sale named

types.says: This structured declaration describes the token, as I say it does. For a fungible mint: a custody arrangement (A) or token terms with an explicit allocation (T).
Per my register, X owns it or has it.
types.signedBy: anyone; typically a registrar or notary

types.says: As of date, it is (or is not) the predicate.
Event E happened.
I have a charge over it: a mortgage or a lien.
This wallet is ...
This wallet is a notary, inspector, registry, arbiter, custodian, auditor or other, per this issuer.
My key was compromised since T.

fungibleDeclaration._comment: The A/H/T documents the /fungible reader accepts for an existing classic SPL fungible mint (docs/fungible-evidence.md).

recipeConditions: control by the token holder only

chainFacts.fact: The wallet that holds the token.
Who signed which statement, and when, in story-registry order.
What the token committed to at creation: the digest of its asset sheet in its origin.
Every origin with an identifier is tagged, so all tokens that claim one asset can be listed.
A burned token (supply 0) reads as retired.
The token's mint, freeze and delegate powers, read from Solana on the asset page.

readerScope._comment: What the Tokenizario reader can read today. Anything outside it can only be restated as data the reader cannot check yet.
readerScope.nft: Metaplex Token Metadata NonFungible on classic SPL Token
readerScope.fungible: Initialized classic SPL fungible mints with at most 18 decimals (/fungible, A/H/T only)
